name: verify compatibility by compiling with an explicit standard flag
definition: Confirm the edited header passes a strict-C++11 compilation via a test translation unit before delivery.
failure_mode: A mismatch that compiles on the default (newer) standard but errors under the strict flag.

name: verify extension behavior against a python fallback implementation
definition: Confirm the compiled cython code agrees with the pure-python reference implementation for a representative computation.
failure_mode: Numerical/type mismatch between the cython and python variants.

name: verify solution against example set before submission
definition: run the implemented function on every provided example and confirm equality to guarantee generalization.
failure_mode: undetected off-by-one or shape bugs appear only when the verifier loads the file fresh

name: wrap a filesystem operation preserving prefix semantics
definition: Implement a delegating wrapper (e.g. async file-open) that preserves path-prefix joining and extra-argument forwarding consistent with the other wrapped methods.
failure_mode: Missing prefixing or dropped arguments yields a wrong call signature
